name: Heuristicas-TSP
description: Python framework to benchmark TSP constructive heuristics on 21 TSPLIB instances (EUC_2D, ATT). Compares 3 novel insertion heuristics (centroid, eccentricity, hybrid) against Nearest Neighbor, Farthest Insertion and Greedy Edge. Generates heatmaps, boxplots and Pareto frontier analysis.
